the GDFT, GDHT, DFT, DHT, DFT-IV, and DHT-IV matrices share the same eigenvalues and eigenspaces.

the eigenvalues of the GDFT, GDHT, DFT-IV, and DCT-IV matrices are the roots of a polynomial equation of order N, where N is the size of the matrices; the eigenvectors are real, symmetric, and orthogonal.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have found the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors set of the four transforms in a unified framework, and we have shown that these matrices can be expressed in terms of the GDFT, GDHT, DFT and DHT matrices, respectively.

the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors of these four transforms can be found in a unified manner, and that they have a close relationship.
